CCIDevice.title: CCI Device
CCIDevice.description: A CXL Type 3 device that ccid manages over CCI/MCTP.

Name.description: A recognisable name for the device

EventMode.description: How ccid gets new event records: Notification or Polling. Not set: off.

MCTPEventInterruptPolicy.description: Notification only. Event Interrupt Settings to set (CXL r3.1 Table 8-57); bits 0-3 select the Informational, Warning, Failure and Fatal logs.

PollingIntervalSec.description: Seconds between polls. Required for Polling; with Notification, used only if the device rejects the policy.
